Class CharacterSelectionController

java.lang.Object
controller.gameFlow.CharacterSelectionController
public class CharacterSelectionController extends Object
Controller for the CharacterSelection view.

Handles all user interactions from the Character Selection window, including character selection and difficulty changes. Delegates message display to the MessageController and handles transitions to the next screen (EnemySelection) after a character is chosen.

Responsibilities:

  • Update character levels when the difficulty is changed.
  • Notify the MessageController when a character is selected.
  • Open the EnemySelection window after messages finish displaying.

      public void characterChosen(CharacterModel chosen)
      Handles the event when a character is chosen by the user. Shows a confirmation message via MessageController and, after the message queue completes, opens the EnemySelection screen.

      chosen - the CharacterModel selected by the user.

    • difficultyChanged

      public void difficultyChanged(Difficulty difficulty, CharacterModel[] characters)
      Handles a change in difficulty. Updates the level of all provided CharacterModel instances according to the selected Difficulty.
      Parameters:
      difficulty - the difficulty chosen by the user.
      characters - the array of characters whose levels will be updated.
